Hi Sylvia — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the proposed next steps to get the trial running so your engineering team can exercise the inference endpoints: 

What we covered:
- Goal: validate inference latency/cost for the anonymized search augmentation workflow (50k queries/day projected).
- Success metrics: p95 latency < 120ms and embedding cost < $0.0008 per call for typical batch size.
- Timeline: 2-week POC, with a mid-point sync at day 7.

Immediate next steps (owners):
1) Ben: share kickoff checklist and temporary API key for staging (attached).
2) Velotech: spin up a small staging env and run the sample ingestion (product@velotech.com).
3) Monica (CS): offer a short onboarding session for your infra engineer to walk through KV caching and batching settings.

Attachments: kickoff checklist (velotech-kickoff-checklist.pdf), mutual-action-plan.xlsx.

Can you confirm timing for the staging spin-up? If we can get a staging endpoint by next Tuesday (2026-09-23) Monica can run the onboarding session on the 24th.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
